svg.title: A4: Final Recommended Architecture diagram
svg.desc: Flowchart showing A4 production pipeline: PDFs to parent-child chunking, then parallel dense and BM25 indexes, hybrid retrieval via RRF, parent context expansion, cross-encoder reranker, top-k parent contexts, grounded answer generation
svg.text: Parent-child + hybrid + RRF + reranker + grounded generation
